description: This Java test source file is for testing the Transistor class in the akka-based control flow library. It contains parameterized tests that verify the behavior of a custom GraphStage (Transistor) with different activation order permutations and limiting conditions for stream elements. The tests involve setting up Akka Streams components, simulating data flow, and validating proper activation and termination sequences.

classes.name: TransistorTest
classes.description: A parameterized JUnit test class for testing the Transistor Akka graph stage implementation with various activation orders and limits.

classes.name: TransistorTest.Parameter
classes.description: A nested class representing a test parameter: a specific activation order and limiting terminal configuration.

classes.name: TransistorTest.Terminal
classes.description: An enum defining the different terminals (COLLECTOR, BASE, EMITTER) used as activation points and limits in the tests.

methods.name: parameters
methods.description: Generates all combinations of activation order permutations and limiting terminal options for parameterized testing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the Akka ActorSystem, test sources, sink, and constructs the Transistor graph for testing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Performs the stream activation test according to the specified parameters, verifying the flow of elements and proper completion or cancellation.

methods.name: isNotLimiting
methods.description: Helper to determine if a given terminal is not the limiting one in the current test parameter.

methods.name: permutations
methods.description: Generates all permutations of a list of elements, used for creating different activation sequences.

methods.name: permutations (int n)
methods.description: Generates all permutations of integers from 0 to n-1.
